description: Assam has proposed the 'GenAI Ready Naari' programme to equip women, including those from tribal and underserved communities, with Generative AI and workplace skills. Supported by the Gates Foundation, the Nimaya Foundation initiative aims to help women build careers and startups.
body_lead: Guwahati: A programme to make women across Assam, including those from tribal areas, GenAI-ready has been proposed to be rolled out in partnership with the Assam Investment Advisory Society (AIAS) and Ashoka University's Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC). The 'GenAI Ready Naari' programme, supported by the Gates Foundation, will be implemented by Nimaya Foundation, co-founded by Navya Nanda and Samyak Chakrabarty in 2021, a release from the organisation said.
